title: Procedural 3d Slider and Preview Hang Fix
description: Fix procedural 3d react renderer parity: restore inspector slider editing (Tree defaultOpen regression), add in-canvas slider overlays wired to setSliderValue, and cache BREP preview evaluation to stop re-running expensive mesh boolean on every UI command (sphere cut with torus hang).
summary: Restored procedural 3d react parity by fixing three root causes: (1) global Tree regression — leaf property rows with controls now default open so Inspector slider Value fields render; (2) in-canvas slider overlays wired end-to-end via dag.slider_overlay_state_json → flow_core/framework_graph wasm → GraphSliderOverlays + setSliderValue; (3) signature-gated preview cache in Procedural3dRuntime stops re-running expensive BREP mesh boolean on viewport-only commands (sphere cut with torus hang). Verified with kernel, dag, procedural-plugin, framework-renderer-react, ui-react vitest, and headless browser smoke on :6018.
